mergedParams.userDescription: Scrolling text overlay with parallax image background.

output.title: Scrolling Text Overlay with Parallax Image Background

prompts.prompt: Create a cinematic parallax scrolling preset with a Ken Burns effect on the background image and smooth continuous text overlay. Think of this like a documentary title sequence where the background image slowly zooms and pans (Ken Burns effect) while text scrolls horizontally across the screen at a different speed, creating a parallax depth effect. The text should have a subtle glow or shadow to ensure readability against varying background colors. Use a BaseLayout container with 'relative overflow-hidden w-full h-full' classes. The ImageAtom background should use a generic effect with scale (1.0 to 1.2) and translateX (-5% to 5%) over the full duration with ease-in-out timing. The scrolling text should be in a TextAtom with a transform effect translating from translateX: 100% to -100% continuously. Add a semi-transparent overlay BaseLayout between the image and text with 'absolute inset-0 bg-black/30' for better text contrast. Consider using an internal effect preset for the text glow that pulses subtly.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout container (relative overflow-hidden) > ImageAtom (absolute inset-0 object-cover) with Ken Burns effect (scale 1.0→1.2, translateX -5%→5%, duration: full, ease-in-out) > BaseLayout overlay (absolute inset-0 bg-black/30) > TextAtom (absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 whitespace-nowrap text-4xl font-bold text-white) with continuous scroll effect (translateX 100%→-100%, linear timing, loop if possible). Apply text-shadow for readability. Use fitDurationTo: 'children' on container. Consider GPU acceleration with will-change-transform on animated elements.

prompts.prompt: Design a vintage film reel style preset where multiple image layers create parallax depth while text scrolls like old movie credits. Imagine editing a retro film opening - the background image moves slowly, a midground semi-transparent image moves at medium speed, and the text scrolls fastest in the foreground. Add film grain and vignette effects to enhance the vintage aesthetic. Use nested BaseLayouts with different z-index values via Tailwind classes like 'z-0', 'z-10', 'z-20'. Each ImageAtom should have different translation speeds: background (translateX: 0% to -10%), midground (translateX: 0% to -20%), creating the parallax effect. The TextAtom should scroll from right to left with a typewriter or film credit font style. Consider adding a subtle flicker effect using opacity keyframes to simulate old projector inconsistencies.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout (relative w-full h-full bg-black) > ImageAtom background (absolute inset-0 z-0 opacity-60) with slow pan (translateX 0%→-10%, 10s, ease-linear) > ImageAtom midground (absolute inset-0 z-10 opacity-40 mix-blend-overlay) with medium pan (translateX 0%→-20%, 7s) > BaseLayout vignette (absolute inset-0 z-20 bg-gradient-radial from-transparent to-black/50) > TextAtom (absolute bottom-10 z-30 text-amber-100 font-serif text-3xl) with fast scroll (translateX 100%→-100%, 5s). Add filter effects for sepia tone and grain. Use internal effect preset for flicker (opacity 0.9→1.0→0.95, random intervals).

prompts.prompt: Build a modern news ticker preset with a blurred, slowly panning background image and crisp scrolling text in a contained lower-third banner. Picture a broadcast news environment where the background provides context but remains out of focus, while important text information scrolls smoothly in a professional lower-third graphic. The text should be in a solid color banner with subtle animation entry. Use a BaseLayout with 'relative w-full h-full' as the container. The ImageAtom background should have a strong blur filter (20-30px) and slow pan effect. Create a lower-third BaseLayout with 'absolute bottom-0 left-0 right-0 h-24 bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-900 to-blue-700' containing the scrolling TextAtom. Add a subtle slide-up animation for the banner entrance using translateY, then begin the text scroll after a short delay.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout container > ImageAtom (absolute inset-0 object-cover filter blur-2xl scale-110) with pan effect (translateX -5%→5%, duration: full, ease-in-out) > BaseLayout lower-third (absolute bottom-0 left-0 right-0 h-24) with entrance animation (translateY 100%→0%, 0.5s, ease-out) and gradient background (bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-900/95 to-blue-700/95 backdrop-blur-sm) > TextAtom (absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-white text-xl font-semibold whitespace-nowrap) with delayed scroll (wait 0.5s, then translateX 100%→-100%, linear). Add drop-shadow-lg to lower-third for depth. Consider using fitDurationTo: 'media' if background is video.

prompts.prompt: Create an immersive parallax preset inspired by video game UI, where the background image has a subtle 3D perspective shift while text scrolls on multiple layers at different depths. Think of this like editing a game trailer where UI elements float at different Z-depths. The background should have a subtle perspective tilt and slow rotation, while multiple text layers scroll at different speeds to enhance the depth perception. Use CSS perspective on the container with 'perspective-1000' class. Apply transform: rotateY animations to the background ImageAtom for the 3D shift effect. Create multiple TextAtom layers with different sizes and opacity values - larger text closer (faster scroll), smaller text farther (slower scroll). Add glow effects to text using text-shadow with neon colors for that gaming aesthetic.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout (relative w-full h-full perspective-1000 bg-black overflow-hidden) > ImageAtom (absolute inset-0 transform-style-preserve-3d) with 3D rotation (rotateY -5deg→5deg, rotateX -2deg→2deg, scale 1.1, ease-in-out) > TextAtom foreground (absolute top-1/3 z-30 text-6xl text-cyan-400 font-bold) with fast scroll and glow (translateX 100%→-100%, 4s, text-shadow: 0 0 20px cyan) > TextAtom midground (absolute top-1/2 z-20 text-4xl text-purple-400 opacity-70) with medium scroll (translateX 100%→-100%, 6s) > TextAtom background (absolute top-2/3 z-10 text-2xl text-pink-400 opacity-50) with slow scroll (translateX 100%→-100%, 8s). Use will-change-transform for all animated elements.

prompts.prompt: Develop a sophisticated editorial magazine preset where the background image uses a subtle zoom-out reveal while text scrolls in an elegant serif font with letter-spacing animations. Visualize editing a high-end fashion or architecture video where every movement is deliberate and refined. The background image should start slightly zoomed in and slowly reveal the full frame, while the text enters with expanded letter-spacing that tightens as it scrolls. Use a BaseLayout with a aspect-ratio constraint for cinematic feel. The ImageAtom should start at scale 1.15 and animate to 1.0 with a gentle ease-out curve. The TextAtom should combine horizontal scroll with a letter-spacing animation (0.5em to 0.1em) for a sophisticated reveal. Add a subtle gradient overlay that shifts opacity to ensure text remains readable throughout.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout (relative w-full aspect-video bg-gray-900 overflow-hidden) > ImageAtom (absolute inset-0 object-cover) with zoom-out (scale 1.15→1.0, duration: 80%, ease-out) > BaseLayout gradient (absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-black/60 via-transparent to-black/40) with opacity fade (opacity 0.3→0.6→0.3) > TextAtom (absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-5xl font-serif text-gray-100 tracking-widest uppercase) with compound animation (translateX 120%→-120% + letterSpacing 0.5em→0.1em, ease-in-out). Use fitDurationTo: 'media' for precise timing. Add mix-blend-mode: difference for dynamic text color.

prompts.prompt: Build a dynamic split-screen parallax preset where the image is divided into vertical slices that move at different speeds while text scrolls through the center. Think of this as a music video edit technique where the background is fragmented for artistic effect. Use multiple ImageAtom components, each showing a portion of the same image with clip-path to create vertical slices. Each slice should have a different translation speed and direction - some moving up, some down, creating a disorienting but engaging parallax effect. The text should scroll horizontally through the center with a bold, high-contrast style. Add a strobe or glitch effect moment midway through for extra impact. This creates a striking visual that works well for energetic content.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout container > 5 ImageAtom slices (absolute top-0 bottom-0 w-1/5) with clip-path (clip-path: inset(0 80% 0 0), inset(0 60% 0 20%), etc.) and different transforms: slice1 (translateY -10%→10%), slice2 (translateY 10%→-10%), slice3 (translateY -5%→5%), slice4 (translateY 15%→-15%), slice5 (translateY -8%→8%), all with different durations. TextAtom (absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 z-50 text-7xl font-black text-white mix-blend-mode-difference) with scroll (translateX 100%→-100%, 5s). Add internal glitch effect preset at 50% mark (rapid translateX/Y and RGB split using text-shadow). Use backdrop-filter on text for additional visual interest.

prompts.prompt: Create a dreamy, ethereal preset with a soft-focus background that slowly breathes (scale pulsing) while text floats across like clouds with varying opacity. Imagine editing a meditation or wellness video where everything flows organically. The background image should have a gaussian blur and subtle scale pulsing (breathing effect), while the text moves in a wave-like pattern combining horizontal scroll with sine-wave vertical movement. Use multiple TextAtom layers with different opacity values to create a ghosting effect. Add color overlay that shifts through calming hues (blue to purple to pink) very gradually. The overall effect should be hypnotic and soothing, with no harsh movements.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout (relative w-full h-full overflow-hidden) > ImageAtom (absolute inset-0 object-cover filter blur-xl scale-125) with breathing effect (scale 1.25→1.35→1.25, 8s, ease-in-out, loop) > BaseLayout color overlay (absolute inset-0 mix-blend-mode-soft-light) with color animation (backgroundColor: #3b82f6→#9333ea→#ec4899, full duration) > TextAtom main (absolute top-1/2 text-6xl font-light text-white/80) with wave motion (translateX 100%→-100% + translateY calculated via sin wave ±30px, 10s) > TextAtom ghost1 (same position, opacity-30, 0.2s delay) > TextAtom ghost2 (same position, opacity-15, 0.4s delay). Use will-change-transform and GPU-accelerated properties only.

prompts.prompt: Design a high-energy sports/action preset where the background image shakes and zooms dynamically while text races across with motion blur trails. Picture editing an extreme sports highlight reel where everything conveys speed and intensity. The background should have rapid micro-shakes combined with punch-in zoom moments, while the text speeds across leaving motion blur trails. Use waveform effects if audio is available to sync the shake intensity to the beat. Create the motion blur effect using multiple TextAtom copies with decreasing opacity and slight position offsets. Add impact frames (brief white flashes) at key moments. Consider using an internal 'earthquake' effect preset for the background shake.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout container > ImageAtom (absolute inset-0 object-cover) with compound effects: shake (translateX/Y ±2% random, 0.1s intervals) + punch zoom (scale 1.0→1.2→1.0 at 30% and 70% marks, 0.3s, ease-out) using waveform effects if available (bassIntensity threshold: 0.7). TextAtom primary (absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 z-50 text-8xl font-black uppercase text-red-500) with speed scroll (translateX 150%→-150%, 2s, ease-in). Motion trail: 3 TextAtom copies with opacity 0.4/0.2/0.1 and translateX offsets of +20px/+40px/+60px. Impact flash: BaseLayout (absolute inset-0 bg-white z-100) with opacity flash (0→1→0, 0.1s) at 30% and 70% marks. Consider audio-reactive waveform effects for shake intensity.

prompts.prompt: Build a minimalist architectural preset where the background image uses precise geometric masking with slow reveal while text scrolls in a clean, monospace font with staggered entry. Think of this as editing an architecture showcase or tech product reveal where precision and cleanliness are paramount. The background image should be revealed through expanding geometric shapes (rectangles growing from center), while text enters in a staggered, typewriter-like fashion before scrolling. Use clip-path animations on the ImageAtom for the geometric reveal. Multiple text lines should enter with increasing delays, creating a cascade effect. Keep the color palette monochromatic with high contrast. Add subtle grid overlay for that technical drawing aesthetic.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout (relative w-full h-full bg-gray-100) > BaseLayout grid (absolute inset-0 opacity-10) with repeating linear gradient for grid lines > ImageAtom (absolute inset-0 object-cover grayscale) with clip-path reveal (clip-path: inset(50% 50% 50% 50%)→inset(0% 0% 0% 0%), 2s, ease-out) > Multiple TextAtom lines (absolute positioned at different heights, font-mono text-black text-2xl) with staggered entry and scroll: line1 (top-1/3, opacity 0→1 at 0.5s, then translateX 0→-100%), line2 (top-1/2, opacity 0→1 at 1s, then translateX 0→-100%), line3 (top-2/3, opacity 0→1 at 1.5s, then translateX 0→-100%). Use backdrop-filter: contrast(1.2) on text container for crisp edges.

prompts.prompt: Create an organic, nature-inspired preset where the background image has a gentle sway motion like trees in wind while text flows across like a river with undulating movement. Visualize editing a nature documentary or environmental campaign where movements mirror natural phenomena. The background should have a subtle pendulum sway (rotate + translateX), while the text follows a flowing river path using bezier curves for movement. Add particle effects (small semi-transparent shapes) that drift across to simulate leaves or snow. Use multiple layers of movement at different speeds to create depth. Implement a color grade that shifts slightly to simulate changing light conditions (golden hour to blue hour).
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout container > ImageAtom (absolute inset-0 object-cover scale-110) with sway effect (rotate -2deg→2deg→-2deg + translateX -2%→2%→-2%, 12s, ease-in-out) > BaseLayout particles container with 5-10 ShapeAtom elements (absolute, circle, 10-20px, opacity-20) with drift animations (translateX -10%→110% + translateY with sine wave ±50px, different durations 8-15s) > BaseLayout color filter (absolute inset-0 mix-blend-mode-multiply) with color shift (backgroundColor: #fbbf24→#3b82f6, full duration, ease-in-out) > TextAtom (absolute top-1/2 text-5xl font-serif text-white) with river flow (custom bezier path using translateX 100%→-100% + translateY sine wave ±40px, 8s, ease-linear). Use will-change sparingly, only on actively animating elements.
